name: 3126-twocount-ruling-03-two-name-groups-in-two-ifs-of-one-path
models:
module core
version 0.1.0
distribution public
source "probe"
key uid string -
key time_ms int ms
module probe
version 0.1.0
distribution public
source "probe"
key x int -
key y int -
key z int -
key val int -
key qty int -
list nums "a list"
list recs "a list"
list items "a list"
list subs "a list"
pack:
format probe
version 0.31.0
distribution public
source "probe"
uses probe
wire bits
layout sequential
count a 8
count b 8 plus 1
presence p 2
if p.1
  group probe.nums count @a @b
    field probe.val 8 uint
  end
end
if p.2
  group probe.recs count @a @b
    field probe.x 8 uint
  end
end
